description: Search BatchData's 155M+ property database by location and attribute filters (e.g. "Phoenix, AZ"), with skip/take pagination. Returns matching property records plus a meta count of total matches. Requires a BatchData API token via _apiKey. Example: batchdata_property_search({ query: "Phoenix, AZ", take: 25, _apiKey: "your-token" })

_apiKey.description: BatchData API token (create one at https://app.batchdata.com)

query.description: Free-text location/search query, e.g. "Phoenix, AZ" or "85001".

searchCriteria.description: Optional: full searchCriteria object for advanced filters (combined with AND). If omitted, `query` is wrapped as { query }.

skip.description: Pagination offset — number of results to skip (default 0).

take.description: Number of results per page (default 25, max 1000; keep <=500 to avoid 502s).

name: batchdata_property_search
title: Batchdata Property Search
